question: One patient is diagnosed with a 4 cm lung cancer without pleural contact in the right upper lobe. The extension study reveals the presence of metastasis in right parahilar nodes, without evidence of distant metastasis. The staging of the tumor will be:
analysis: The tumor is 4 cm in size, which corresponds to T2a in the TNM classification. The presence of metastasis in right parahilar nodes indicates N1 nodal involvement. There is no evidence of distant metastasis, so M0. According to the AJCC 8th edition staging system, a T2a N1 M0 lung cancer is classified as Stage IIB.
